status: Protocol frozen before cohort preparation or model interventions
question: Does the previous plane/residual counterfactual result generalize within the available clips, and where does it fail?
scope: Offline recorded maps and diagnostic NN inputs only; no production code/model/threshold change, no simulator/hardware/control

main_input_strata.high_coverage_low_relief: both observed fractions >=.98, max height span <=.20m, no occupied context in either51patch
main_input_strata.partial_coverage_low_relief: max height span <=.20m and no occupied context, not high coverage

sampling.previous_handpicked_xy_excluded_by_grid: (-.48,12.24) is not on1m world sampling grid

decomposition: H=P+R with OLS plane over51x51; residual includes real microterrain and errors, not assumed noise

effects.primary_direction_summary: mean absolute eight-channel effect; signed effects retained
effects.residual_dominant: mean(abs(E_R))>=2*mean(abs(E_P)), among materially changed main samples

additional_controls: old residual scaled to new RMS at new plane
new residual scaled to old RMS at new plane
restore residual only where both frames observed
restore residual only on new nearest-padding cells

noise_stress.purpose: controlled sensitivity, not proof real recorded errors are IID

reporting: all eligible/selected counts by stratum, clip/filter/lag
effect distributions plus individual traces, no only-success examples
input masks, full eight outputs, input hashes and selection manifest
spatial/time overlap acknowledged; no iid confidence claims
no physical ground truth or real-world failure-rate calibration inferred
